name: Palm Reading
overview: The Bible clearly condemns seeking guidance from familiar spirits, wizards, and those who practice divination, warning that such actions defile the believer and provoke God's judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6,27; Deuteronomy 18:10). Instead of turning to occult practices like palm reading, believers are called to seek the Lord alone, trusting in His living power rather than consulting the dead or spiritists (Isaiah 8:19). The true hope and salvation come from Christ, the humble King who brings deliverance to His people (Zechariah 9:9).
